A.name: Local IAM
A.definition: Identification, authentication and access decisions entirely on-device; credentials stored locally; local enforcement.

B.name: Cloud-backend IAM
B.definition: PEP on PDE, PDP in remote cloud; subdivided by CRA scope (B-FULL, B-3P, B-HYBRID).

A_B.name: Hybrid IAM
A_B.definition: Both local and remote IAM (e.g. local fallback + cloud primary); both local and remote IAM profiles apply.
A_B.original_doc: Many PDEs combine A and B (D2.3)

C.name: No / inadequate IAM
C.definition: No authentication, hardcoded credentials, or nominal access control; subdivided C-CRIT, C-JUST, C-IMPL.

D.name: Integration IAM
D.definition: Integrates into customer IAM (LDAP, AD, RADIUS, SAML/OIDC); manufacturer provides integration, does not operate IAM.

B_FULL.name: Full CRA Scope
B_FULL.survey: Q5 = manufacturer's own cloud / commissioned development
B_FULL.definition: Remote IAM qualifies as remote data processing solution under CRA Art. 3(2); full Annex I on device and cloud IAM.

B_3P.name: Third-Party (due diligence)
B_3P.definition: Third-party IAM outside CRA remote data processing scope; Art. 13(5) due diligence; PDE still meets essential requirements.

B_HYBRID.name: Hybrid Scope
B_HYBRID.survey: Q5 = partial / orchestration on third-party IdP
B_HYBRID.definition: Manufacturer layer: B-FULL; underlying IdP: B-3P; both apply simultaneously.

C_CRIT.name: Critical Non-Compliance
C_CRIT.definition: Worst case; multiple violations 2(b), 2(d), 2(e), 2(i); immediate remediation.

C_JUST.name: Justified Absence
C_JUST.survey: Q3b path with documented risk justification
C_JUST.definition: No auth with Art. 13(4)-style justification; rare; verify vs Recital 9.

C_IMPL.name: Implementation Required
C_IMPL.definition: Must implement authentication or produce justification; practical outcome for connected PDE: implement auth.

HIGH.from_survey: Q6 includes physical safety and/or connected systems
